definitions.explanation: A feeling of not knowing how to respond or act in an unexpected situation.

examples.japanese: {戸惑|とまど}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。
⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戸惑|とまど}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戸惑|とまど}い。

notes:
{戸惑|とまど}い is a noun meaning confusion or bewilderment when facing an unexpected situation.

RELATED VERB:
⟦{戸惑|とまど}う→戸惑う：06036_tomadou⟧: to be confused, bewildered, perplexed

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {戸惑|とまど}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel confused
- {戸惑|とまど}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: unable to hide one's confusion
- {戸惑|とまど}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧/⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: expression of bewilderment
- {戸惑|とまど}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel perplexed

USAGE:
Describes the feeling of not knowing how to react or respond in an unfamiliar or unexpected situation. Often used when facing new environments, sudden changes, or unusual requests.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{困惑|こんわく}→困惑：09170_konwaku⟧: perplexity, bewilderment (more formal)
- ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧: confusion, chaos (stronger, more disordered)
